head_commit.message:
fix(ci): 移除失效 AstroCS.wiki gitlink 修复 hosted checkout [V8-CI-010]

- 根因: 索引含 160000 gitlink 但仓库无 .gitmodules → actions/checkout fatal
  'No url found for submodule path AstroCS.wiki' → 双平台 workflow run 34000501601/34000501567 首步即败
- 该 gitlink 源自历史 chore(wiki) sync 提交(a2cd3f3f), wiki 内容经 GitHub wiki 页同步, 不应作为 submodule 引用
- 修复仅移除索引登记; 磁盘 AstroCS.wiki/ 目录保留(owner 本地 wiki clone, 转为未跟踪)
- 归属: V8-CI-010 hosted 双平台验证发现的 P0 阻塞

head_commit.message:

- .github/workflows/fatduck.yml: select-candidate(hosted, API 查询 Windows CI 成功 run+同 SHA Linux PASS+candidate artifact)/fatduck-validate([self-hosted, fatduck-realdata], 零 checkout/零 repo script, 固定 harness 入口 run_validation.ps1)/notify-owner(仅此 job issues:write, 单一固定 Owner Review Issue, 变量缺失结构化跳过不伪造)
- 触发仅 workflow_run(AstroCS Windows CI completed)+schedule 每 6h; 无手动触发; concurrency 不取消 running
- actions/download-artifact v8.0.1 在线锁定 3e5f45b2 并追加 actions.lock.json(4 entries 复验 PASS); select-candidate 显式双重校验 head_branch==main+conclusion==success
- ci/select_candidate.py: 纯 stdlib+GITHUB_TOKEN 环境变量, no-candidate exit 3 结构化; +29 离线单测(共 180 OK); plan-only 57/71/7/61 回归不变

head_commit.message:
feat(ci): V8-CI-007 双平台 workflow、action 锁与 CI 辅助链 [V8-CI-007]

- .github/workflows: ci-linux.yml(ubuntu-24.04, push main+dispatch+schedule)+ci-windows.yml(windows-2022, push main+dispatch); permissions contents:read; persist-credentials:false; 全 action 锁完整 SHA; 无算法命令
- ci/actions.lock.json + verify_actions_lock.py: checkout v7.0.1/upload-artifact v5.0.0(+v4.6.2 参考) 在线 api.github.com 查询生成并机器复验(offline 结构校验模式)
- ci/bootstrap.py: --policy ci/toolchain.policy.json --platform 逐项工具链校验(缺失 exit 2 结构化 repair 报告); ci/select_profile.py: push→linux-main/schedule→linux-deep/dispatch 白名单
- ci/validate_candidate.py: candidate zip 五类校验(三清单/哈希双向完备/成员排除/溯源必填); ci_windows_driver.py 连带 --zip 确定性打包
- ci/tests/test_workflow_lock.py +38 用例(共 151 OK); plan-only 57/71/7/61 回归不变; toolchain.policy.json 误覆盖已恢复(0 diff)
- 台账补登 V8-CI-006 CLOSED(847a7a6b)
